confirm.subject: Confirm your email for Coach Poulpy
confirm.body:
Hello,

Open this link to confirm your email and start syncing your training between your devices:

{link}

The link works for 24 hours. Until then, your training stays on your phone only.

If you didn’t sign up for Coach Poulpy, ignore this email: no account is used without this confirmation.

reset.subject: Reset your Coach Poulpy password
reset.body:
Hello,

Open this link to choose a new password:

{link}

The link works once, for 1 hour. Choosing a new password signs you out on every device.

If you didn’t ask for this, ignore this email: your password stays as it is.

test.subject: Coach Poulpy test email
test.body:
Hello,

This is the test email sent from the Coach Poulpy admin. If it reached you, emails go out with the saved settings.

There is nothing to do.
